added_comments.text: Work in integer minor units so the adjustment covers the full difference exactly, which can exceed one minor unit when several lines round in the same direction.

rationale: The agent replaced the hardcoded ±0.01 adjustment (the actual defect) with a computation of the true difference in integer minor units, fixing the whole class of multi-cent rounding discrepancies rather than special-casing the reported $0.02 example. It reuses the existing per-currency minorUnits metadata and doesn't touch money.ts's JPY whole-yen/rounding logic, so the protected JPY behavior remains intact.
